content.text: {"core": "Fulfillment registers satisfaction as complete — the state where a desire has been met and rests. In Imagination, it operates on the image of the wanted thing, sealing the picture as already possessed. Unacknowledged, the sealing runs unmarked, so the imagined completion is treated as accomplished fact and the reaching that would meet it in condition never starts.", "sheetLine": "The wish is being enjoyed as finished while the thing itself stays imagined."}
